_notes.status: Minimal starting point — only includes a server with no external credentials required, since we don't yet know your DB provider or whether you want GitHub/Postgres MCP access wired up.
_notes.postgres: Add a postgres MCP server here once backend/prisma/schema.prisma confirms the DB provider — e.g. { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres", "${DATABASE_URL}"] }. Use whatever your actual .env variable is named (commonly DATABASE_URL for Prisma, but confirm).
_notes.github: Add a github MCP server here if you want Claude Code to read/write issues or PRs directly — needs a GITHUB_TOKEN env var, not yet added since it's optional.
_notes.secrets_warning: Never hardcode real API keys/tokens in this file. Always use ${ENV_VAR} placeholders resolved from your shell or .env, matching backend/.gitignore's existing .env/.env.* rules.
